title: Jesus Listens: Daily Devotional Prayers of Peace, Joy, and Hope (A 365-Day Prayer Book)
author: Sarah Young
target_audience: Christians seeking a daily devotional practice
Readers looking for guided daily prayers
Individuals desiring spiritual encouragement and comfort
People interested in deepening their relationship with Jesus
Fans of Sarah Young's previous works
core_themes: Daily prayer and communion with God
Seeking peace, joy, and hope in daily life
primary_purpose: To provide readers with daily, Scripture-based prayers designed to cultivate intimacy with Jesus while offering comfort, encouragement, and spiritual growth throughout the year.

structure_format.organization: 365 undated entries, each structured as a heartfelt prayer inspired by biblical passages
features: Consistent prayer format for each day

key_concepts_lessons: Regular, intentional prayer fosters a stronger spiritual life.
Honest, open conversation with Jesus provides comfort and guidance.
Scriptural truths underpin each day’s prayer, rooting personal devotion in biblical foundation.
Seeking God's presence, peace, and joy can anchor a believer in hope, even in difficult times.
Spiritual growth is a daily, continual process.
notable_features: Each entry references relevant Bible verses
Accessible for readers at any stage of faith
Designed for daily use and spiritual consistency
Continuation of Sarah Young’s popular devotional style
cultural_historical_context: Released in 2021, 'Jesus Listens' responds to a modern context marked by uncertainty, personal struggles, and a renewed interest in spiritual resources for daily living. It follows the enormous success of 'Jesus Calling,' building on a widespread appetite for daily devotional materials.
reception_impact: Became a bestselling devotional on release
Praised for its accessibility, warmth, and encouragement
Widely adopted by Christians seeking daily guidance and comfort
Critically, some note its repetitive format, but it is appreciated for readers valuing routine and stability
Cemented Sarah Young’s influence in modern devotional literature
comparable_titles: New Morning Mercies: A Daily Gospel Devotional by Paul David Tripp
The One Year Book of Prayers by William J. Petersen and Randy Petersen
My Utmost for His Highest by Oswald Chambers
